title: MusicDrop v1.4.5 Available
changelog:
• Public Directory Saving for Recent Files: Audio files now save directly to /Music/MusicDrop/ and videos to /Movies/MusicDrop/ with instant MediaStore indexing, making them visible immediately in Android's Recent files tab and file managers
• Native MP3 & Video File Sharing: Share downloaded MP3 tracks and MP4 videos directly via Android system share sheet (WhatsApp, Telegram, Quick Share, etc.) from player options and Library
• Video Mode Stability: Fixed video switching app/playback stopping; audio playback continues seamlessly and without interruption while official synced video is displayed
